settings.enabled_login_help: Show the PoW security challenge inside the Login form.
settings.enabled_signup_help: Show the PoW security challenge inside the Sign Up form.
settings.enabled_forgot_help: Show the PoW security challenge inside the Forgot Password form.
settings.level_help: The work every visitor's browser must do. Times are approximate, measured on a recent PC; phones are 3–6 times slower. With adaptive difficulty enabled, networks that behave suspiciously automatically get up to two extra steps.
settings.level_2: Level 2 – Balanced (≈ 0.1 s on a PC, recommended)
settings.level_3: Level 3 – Strong (≈ 1–3 s on a PC, 5–10 s on a phone)
settings.adaptive_help: Automatically raises the difficulty for networks with repeated failed checks or many sign-ups in a few minutes, and for everyone during a site-wide attack. Uses short-lived anonymous counters in the cache; nothing is stored.
settings.protect_token_endpoint_label: Also protect the API login endpoint (/api/token)
settings.protect_token_endpoint_help: Bots can log in by calling /api/token directly, skipping the login form. When enabled, direct calls must carry a CAPTCHA token (GET /api/powcaptcha/challenge?action=token). Turn this off if mobile apps or other integrations log in through the API without a browser.
settings.log_enabled_help: Stores the time, form, outcome and technical reason of recent checks. Only the latest 30 successes and 30 failures are kept.
settings.log_ip_label: Record and display IP addresses in CAPTCHA logs (warning: GDPR)
settings.log_ip_help: WARNING: an IP address is personal data under the GDPR. By enabling this option you, as data controller, are responsible for having a valid legal basis (e.g. legitimate interest in security), for describing the processing in your privacy policy, for limiting retention and for handling data-subject requests. Non-compliant use may constitute a GDPR violation and lead to penalties. IPs are kept only while the entry is among the latest 30 passed and 30 failed events, or until the log is cleared. Disabled by default: if you do not need it, leave it off. This is not legal advice; if in doubt, consult a professional.

logs.title: Recent CAPTCHA events
logs.help: The latest 30 successful and 30 failed checks are kept; older entries are deleted automatically. IP addresses are only recorded and displayed if explicitly enabled in the settings.
logs.confirm_clear: Delete all CAPTCHA log entries? This cannot be undone.
logs.ip_banner_enabled: Warning: IP addresses are personal data (GDPR). Make sure you have a legal basis, have disclosed them in your privacy policy and do not keep them longer than necessary. Clear the log when you no longer need it.
logs.ip_banner_disabled: IP addresses are not recorded or displayed (disabled by default for GDPR compliance). To record them, enable the 'Record and display IP addresses in CAPTCHA logs' option in the settings above, after assessing your GDPR obligations.

reasons.bad_solution: Wrong or insufficient proof of work
